recordedBy: Session C, lane NH (Part F remainder)
purpose: Route descriptors for the New Hampshire source routes that are KNOWN and NOT WIRED, shaped so another lane can register each as an autonomous obligation. This file is a DESCRIPTION of the frontier, never a scheduler and never a permission grant. Nothing here is wired by the lane that wrote it.

vocabularies.note: PERMISSION AND TRANSPORT ARE ORTHOGONAL (RULING 182). A transport value in this file is never a permission verdict, and a failure to retrieve a robots.txt is never a rule.

readingRules: A route here is a REPRESENTATION of a record, never the record (RULING 206). A 403 on one host is a fact about that host.
One wired route never retires the others for the same record (RULING 207). The CFS API being wired is exactly why the filed-report PDFs still matter: they carry facts the API does not publish.
A disposition closes a RouteTask and never closes the record obligation (RULING 205).
Nothing in this file may become an absence. A route not yet walked says nothing about what New Hampshire holds.

permissionMeasurements.finding: A standard Drupal robots.txt. Every Disallow is a CMS internal. Zero directives name a lobbyist, election, campaign-finance, candidate or filings path. Confirms the record at data/method/knowledge.json line 4096.

The APEX host answered 503 Service Unavailable. THAT IS TRANSPORT AND NOT PERMISSION. docs/sources.md line 398 names the campaign-finance PDF series on this apex host; permission for those paths is read from the www host above, and the 503 is recorded so a later session does not mistake it for either a rule or an absence.
The Angular application shell, not a robots file. An ABSENCE OF PUBLISHED RESTRICTIONS, never a 200 that grants permission: a SPA catch-all is not a rule.

PROVEN A CATCH-ALL RATHER THAN ASSUMED ONE: this host returns a byte-identical 837-byte page for /robots.txt and for /this-path-does-not-exist-zzz. So the API host publishes no robots.txt either. This is the host the wired money route actually calls, and the repo previously recorded this only for cfs.sos.nh.gov.
fetch failed at the transport layer from this client. CANNOT_TELL for the host, and it is re-read with a different client rather than treated as a rule (RULING 182).

A FAMILY-LEVEL PERMISSION FACT, MEASURED RATHER THAN GENERALISED: five .nh.gov hosts each answer the SAME 2103-byte Drupal robots.txt with the same 57 directives. All 34 Disallow lines were enumerated and every one is a CMS internal — /core/, /profiles/, /admin/, /search/, /user/login, /user/register, /media/oembed, the README files and their /index.php twins. Nothing disallows a court, a school district, a rate table, a bank regulator, an election, a candidate, a campaign-finance filing or a lobbyist registry.

CORRECTS THE RECORD. states/nh/NOTES.md has this host refusing rungs 2 to 4 with a Cloudflare challenge including on robots.txt. Its robots.txt answered 200 to this client today with an ordinary permissive Drupal ruleset. So the CHALLENGE IS ON THE HTML, NOT ON THE PERMISSION DOCUMENT, and the permission question is ANSWERED rather than unanswerable.
The entire file is 'User-agent: *' followed by an empty 'Disallow:', which is the standard form for permitting everything.

The node client's request failed at the transport layer, exactly as states/nh/NOTES.md records for this host: node is refused on a TLS/HTTP2 fingerprint where curl is served. THIS IS TRANSPORT. The permission basis for this host is the earlier curl read recorded in states/nh/NOTES.md, which found a published Crawl-delay of 10 seconds.

namedBlockers.precisely: The certified ballot and the registry disagree on the FORM of a person's forename: the ballot carries 'Jon Raiche' and 'Meg Hagaman'; the registry carries 'Raiche, Jonathan M. (Raiche, Jon )' and the committee 'Meg For Merrimack' for 'Meghan Hagaman'. Both filers have real 2026 money for Merrimack County Attorney. The strict matching bar correctly refuses both, so both are LEADs and neither renders.
namedBlockers.whatUnblocks: AN AUTHORITATIVE IDENTITY, NOT A LOOSER STRING TEST. Any of: the CFS filer-detail endpoint if it publishes a candidate identifier; the certified filing PDF, which lists candidates as they filed; or the parenthesised alias the agency itself publishes inside filerName, read as a published alias rather than guessed. Lowering namesAgree is REFUSED — a stranger's money on a named person's card is a worse failure than an empty section by a wide margin.
namedBlockers.whatContinuesMeanwhile: The money is ACQUIRED and held in the snapshot as two LEAD records with their committee ids. Nothing is lost; it is not yet attributable.
